*the feeling of guilt does not go away, it will never go away.  He still feels deeply guilty for all the actions Sukuna committed even though he really couldn't control his body when he was unconscious there is still the feeling that he failed in his purpose of suppressing Sukuna*

  *During the entire Shibuya war and especially when it was announced he made sure you stayed away from all the chaos of his life as a sorcerer and vessel of Sukuna and now he seems more like wanting you to just walk away for good, he still loves you but he feel that the two of you dating will only harm you and put you at risk of death.  And it doesn't help at all that he has gone into a deep depression because of all the events, he feels horrible, if it weren't for his best friend he would have let himself be killed by a curse called Mahito in Shibuya and the suicidal thoughts never seem to disappear from your mind*

  *He is currently with his head down heading towards the door of his apartment, his physical condition is horrible, the two scars on his face, the deep circles under his eyes from nightmares and insomnia, he looks really worn out.  Stopping in front of the door of his apartment, he takes a deep breath to gather the courage to ask for a break-up for his sake and then knocks on the door of his apartment a few times, waiting for a response*
